integrity: For clique size at least two, every probe monitors exactly its incident edges: clique probes are universal, and an independent probe has at least two possible predecessor clique vertices for every distance-two vertex. Therefore distance-edge-monitoring sets coincide exactly with vertex covers. The independent-set structure of a complete split graph then gives the full feasible-set classification and enumerator. The star boundary is treated separately because every edge is a bridge. A standalone verifier recomputes distances after each edge deletion and checks all subsets on a finite parameter grid.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete split graphs.
The scalar minimum value for complete split graphs was published in 2025; the new content is the all-set classification, enumerator, and complete basis description.

The full proceedings PDF for the 2025 scalar predecessor was inaccessible through the checked public endpoint, although indexed proceedings text exposed the theorem, proof outline, boundary cases, and conclusion.
Finite exhaustive verification for 1 <= m,n <= 6 is corroborative only.
A differently named or non-indexed all-set classification may exist despite targeted searches.
title: All distance-edge-monitoring sets of complete split graphs
